verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Activepieces serves an llms.txt at https://www.activepieces.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured, LLM-oriented product summary, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The docs are also published as per-page .md URLs, which suggests agent-readable markdown docs, although the root docs.md returned 404. Missing for 10: confirmation of llms.txt depth or coverage (e.g. a full llms-full.txt index), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Open-source workflow automation and AI agents.
